'''Kuvuta Pindi''' was a [[Color/Legends|green]]-skinned [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|woman]].<ref name="Strange Allies" /> In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> as part of a [[Slavery/Legends|slavery]] operation, she abducted 10 [[Clone Wars/Legends|war]] orphans from [[Abregado-rae/Legends|Abregado-rae]] and took them to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Fondor/Legends|Fondor]]. There she posed as the [[Youngling/Legends|younglings]]' blind handler, and she fooled the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Nuru Kungurama]] and the [[Swoop/Legends|swoop]] biker [[Gizman|Gizz]] into taking them to the placement center on [[Foless/Legends|Foless]]. On the trip to the planet, Gizz flirted with Pindi. On [[Foless/Legends|Foless]], Pindi directed the orphans to take a particular-colored [[Airbus/Legends|airbus]]. This clued Gizz and the Jedi that she was faking her affliction, and gave chase. Once they caught up, she accosted her partner, the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Dool Pundar]], to try to deceive the Jedi that she had been abducted. The airbus crashed, and Pindi continued to lie about her blindness. In a moment of distraction, she took the orphan [[Charky]] hostage with a hidden knife, although the young [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] bit her and forced her to resort to running away. Gizz and the Jedi pursued her into a swamp, which was marked with a "danger" sign. Drawing a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]], she was about to shoot Gizz for ruining her plans, when a creature rose up behind her and [[Death/Legends|devoured]] her, although Kungurama tried to warn her. Pundar was subsequently taken into custody and the orphans were placed with new families.<ref name="Strange Allies" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kuvuta Pindi appears in [[2011]]'s ''[[The Clone Wars: Strange Allies]]'', a comic tie-in to the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Secret Missions]]'' series.
